classification: experiment protocol; not empirical evidence or mathematical law

falsifier.candidate: Within-lineage volume improves a prespecified observable beyond a declared finite model prediction or prespecified positive floor at a fixed finite design.
falsifier.causalClaimLabels: Original (ii)/(iii) are not defined in the supplied excerpt; no causal estimand is invented. All causal interpretations remain unmeasured without a separately bound observable intervention/design.
conditions: Specified training/aggregation process and provenance under fixed quality/context
Prespecified finite comparison, effect threshold and valid uncertainty at its actual sampling unit
Observable truth/quality if the endpoint requires it
Observable intervention and justified causal design for causal claims
notEstablished: Same label proves independent or identical lineage quality
A universal asymptotic floor from finite output
falsifier.restriction: A decreasing finite curve alone does not refute a positive asymptotic floor. Any claim about that limit requires a bridge from a specified model/theorem or remains unmeasured. A fitted floor is not a ground-truth lower bound.

order: Freeze protocol bytes and digest before any dataset retrieval. A digest is a byte commitment, not admission/publication or a native receipt.
Owner selects dataset snapshot, license and permitted operations. Bind the separate run manifest and freeze its digest before retrieval; do not fetch under null fields.
Record exposure provenance, including this session, unknown training exposure, selection rules and interventions before inspecting evaluation outcomes.
Retrieve only the selected bytes; verify exact snapshot/digest and licensing. Persist exact retrieved identity and record any version change explicitly.
Use exploratory data only to fix finite model hypothesis, effect threshold, analysis and stopping. Never tune these using holdout outcomes.

Freeze the analysis/run manifest and its digest before opening holdout. Split at the declared independent unit or dependent block boundary; near duplicates/shared lineage units must not leak across splits.
Execute exactly the recorded design; retain all draws, errors, omissions, failed runs and actual model/data/compute versions.
Report all prespecified outcomes including failure of the proposed falsifier. No optional stopping or posthoc endpoint replacement. Revisions require new identities and untouched original outcomes.

exposure.thisSession: Saw experimental descriptions and mathematical counterexamples; no dataset retrieved for1a by this lane. This statement does not certify absence from model training or other sessions.

resultSchema.causal: unmeasured if intervention, assignment justification or causal estimand are absent, even with descriptive observations
resultSchema.delivery: No dataset, keys, private store or private executor is included; actual public availability must be verified separately
resultSchema.descriptive: unmeasured if endpoint, truth/quality, observation design or data are absent
resultSchema.outcome: null until real execution; then prespecified pass/fail/inconclusive with actual uncertainty; never substitute a synthetic test
resultSchema.overallStatus: unmeasured until required binding, legal data retrieval and execution exist

reuse.lineageAndK: O8 definitions and model labels; no inferred causal groups
reuse.priorEvidence: O2/O6 model-scoped proofs are not measurements of this empirical experiment
reuse.uncertainty: O5 finite-block error allocation only when its actual independent-unit and calibration hypotheses are met; not default for pairs

scope: Test only an explicitly bound finite model/data/aggregation/training claim. The label model-collapse supplies no generative model, causal identification or universal floor. This protocol does not choose one.
